newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-S. Elec upped at Goldman, BZW.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-S. Elec upped at Goldman, BZW.

text.p: Goldman Sachs said on Thursday it had raised Southern Electric Plc to a "market outperformer" from "market performer," while market sources said BZW also upgraded the stock to "buy" from "hold."
The stock was up 4p at 413-1/2 by 1335 GMT in volume of 800,289 shares.
Goldman repeated a price target of 436p on Southern Electric. Further detail on both upgrades was not immediately available.
On Wednesday, the UK's last independent electricity distributor posted a drop in year-end pre-tax profit to 255.5 million stg, in line with expectations.
